route.description: keep as a loan on terms; repay through a payment batch, into the person's approved SGD account at a Singapore bank (FOUNDER-32 while they have none); convert to shares, approved now and effective once ACRA registers the allotment (FR-EQ-06); waive (FR-EQ-07); or safe: turn it into a recorded SAFE or convertible note the person holds, Dr the director's account · Cr 2700 on approval (FR-EQ-18). Left out, the organisation's default route (founders.default_route), keep.
